name: WORKSPACE_DIR
purpose: Root for local working data and projects not managed through Git or synchronization.

name: NEXTCLOUD_DIR
purpose: Root of the locally synchronized Nextcloud files.

name: PERSONAL_DIR
purpose: Root for personal files and data.

name: INBOX_DIR
purpose: Capture location for unprocessed tasks and incoming items.

name: TICKLER_DIR
purpose: Tasks and notes deferred until a specified future date.

name: WAITING_FOR_DIR
purpose: Tasks delegated to or blocked by another person or event.

name: ACTION_DIR
purpose: Current actionable tasks that are not assigned to a project.

name: WORK_PROJECTS_DIR
purpose: Active work project directories and their task notes.

name: TO_ARCHIVE_DIR
purpose: Items awaiting review and transfer to an archive.

name: SOMEDAY_DIR
purpose: Ideas and tasks that may be considered later, without a current commitment.

name: TEACHING_DIR
purpose: Teaching materials, course data, and teaching administration.

name: TEACHING_THESES_DIR
purpose: Thesis supervision materials and student thesis work.

name: CHECKLISTS_DIR
purpose: Reusable checklists for recurring work and procedures.

name: REVIEWS_DIR
purpose: Periodic review notes and supporting material.
